cohen-kadesh: Rudolph Cohen, "Did I Excavate Kadesh-Barnea?" Biblical Archaeology Review 7:3 (1981)
hermas-shepherd: The Shepherd of Hermas (Rome, 2nd century AD), in Michael W. Holmes, The Apostolic Fathers (3rd ed., 2007)
joines-serpent: Karen Randolph Joines, Serpent Symbolism in the Old Testament (1974)
maimonides-eight-chapters: Moses Maimonides, Eight Chapters (Shemonah Peraqim), introduction to his commentary on Mishnah Avot (about 1168)
maimonides-helek: Moses Maimonides, Introduction to Perek Helek (Mishnah Sanhedrin 10), in his Commentary on the Mishnah (about 1168)
mazar-rehov: Amihai Mazar and Nava Panitz-Cohen, "It Is the Land of Honey: Beekeeping at Tel Rehov," Near Eastern Archaeology 70:4 (2007)
mishnah-parah: Mishnah, tractate Parah ("The Red Heifer"), compiled about AD 200
pesikta-drk: Pesikta de-Rav Kahana, homilies for the festivals and special Sabbaths (Land of Israel, about AD 500)
pseudo-philo-lab: Pseudo-Philo, Biblical Antiquities (Liber Antiquitatum Biblicarum, 1st century AD), trans. D. J. Harrington in Charlesworth, Old Testament Pseudepigrapha 2 (1985)
rothenberg-timna: Beno Rothenberg, Timna: Valley of the Biblical Copper Mines (1972)
targum-psj-numbers: Targum Pseudo-Jonathan on Numbers, an expansive Aramaic paraphrase (final form after AD 600, with much older material)
felder-troubling: Cain Hope Felder, Troubling Biblical Waters: Race, Class, and Family (1989)
bailey-africans: Randall C. Bailey, "Beyond Identification: The Use of Africans in Old Testament Poetry and Narratives," in Cain Hope Felder, ed., Stony the Road We Trod: African American Biblical Interpretation (1991)
vanseters-sihon: John Van Seters, "The Conquest of Sihon's Kingdom: A Literary Examination," Journal of Biblical Literature 91 (1972)
bartlett-sihon: John R. Bartlett, "The Conquest of Sihon's Kingdom: A Literary Re-examination," Journal of Biblical Literature 97 (1978)
christensen-wars: Duane L. Christensen, "Num 21:14–15 and the Book of the Wars of Yahweh," Catholic Biblical Quarterly 36 (1974)
davis-dsseb: Craig Davis, Dead Sea Scrolls English Bible, website translation with notes (dssenglishbible.com), page on 4Q27 (4QNum-b)
keil-delitzsch-pentateuch: C. F. Keil and F. Delitzsch, Biblical Commentary on the Old Testament: The Pentateuch, trans. James Martin (1864–65)
luzzatto-torah: Samuel David Luzzatto (Shadal), Commentary on the Torah (1871–76)
